issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement printFarmSong() in Farm (mentions printFarmSong in problem_statement.md), but both the template and the provided solution use the method name singFarmSong() instead. This mismatch between the documented method name and the actual template/solution method name can confuse students about which method to implement or test against.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either update the problem statement to reference singFarmSong() (and any occurrences of printFarmSong) or rename the method in the template and solution to printFarmSong() so the documented task name matches the code.

issues.suggestedFix: Make the naming consistent: either rename the method in the template and solution from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong(), or update the problem statement (and UML) to instruct students to implement singFarmSong().
